topic.title: Language Pretraining, Sequence Generation, and Tokenization
topic.area: Language Models and Natural Language Processing
topic.overview: Language models depend on how text is represented, what prediction task supplies training signals, and how generation is evaluated. This cluster includes sequence-to-sequence pretraining, paraphrasing, retrieval augmentation, translation, and tokenizer analysis. Several methods learn reusable structure by reconstructing text from related or partially observed language rather than treating every downstream task separately.
topic.whyItMatters: Choices made before fine-tuning can determine data efficiency, multilingual coverage, and the quality of generated text. Tokenization also affects what information a model can represent economically and how languages are distinguished.
topic.evolution: Earlier representatives concern discriminative parsing, translation, and probabilistic language modeling. The 2019–2022 work emphasizes masked sequence generation, multilingual reconstruction, and large-scale retrieval. Recent papers study continuous latent generation and tokenizer behavior, including efficient language identification derived from probabilistic token models.
openQuestions: Which pretraining objectives transfer reliably across both languages and generation tasks?
How should tokenizer quality be evaluated beyond average sequence length?

papers.title: PIXIU: A Comprehensive Benchmark, Instruction Dataset and Large Language Model for Finance
papers.tldr: PIXIU combines financial instruction data, the LLaMA-based FinMA model, and an eight-task benchmark into an open research framework.

papers.title: PLANNER: Generating Diversified Paragraph via Latent Language Diffusion Model
papers.tldr: PLANNER combines diffusion-based semantic paragraph planning with autoregressive decoding to generate fluent long-form text efficiently.

papers.title: Revisiting Out-of-distribution Robustness in NLP: Benchmarks, Analysis, and LLMs Evaluations
papers.tldr: BOSS introduces harder NLP distribution shifts and reveals different strengths for fine-tuned domain models and large models using in-context learning.

papers.title: Structured Voronoi Sampling
papers.tldr: SVS builds a Hamiltonian Monte Carlo sampler from language-model probabilities and improves evaluated distributional fidelity and text control.

papers.title: Text Alignment Is An Efficient Unified Model for Massive NLP Tasks
papers.tldr: A compact text-alignment model handles diverse language-evaluation tasks and often matches or exceeds much larger models in reported comparisons.

papers.title: Textually Pretrained Speech Language Models
papers.tldr: TWIST initializes speech language models from pretrained text models, improving over cold starts in automatic and human evaluations.

papers.title: Unified Segment-to-Segment Framework for Simultaneous Sequence Generation
papers.tldr: Seg2Seg learns when to wait and when to generate through a shared segment-based framework for streaming sequence tasks.

papers.title: YouTube-ASL: A Large-Scale, Open-Domain American Sign Language-English Parallel Corpus
papers.tldr: YouTube-ASL expands paired ASL-English training data and enables improved fine-tuned and nontrivial zero-shot translation results on How2Sign.

papers.title: BBox-Adapter: Lightweight Adapting for Black-Box Large Language Models
papers.tldr: BBox-Adapter uses positive and negative domain examples to adapt API-only language models, reporting performance gains and lower training and inference costs.

papers.title: Contrastive Preference Optimization: Pushing the Boundaries of LLM Performance in Machine Translation
papers.tldr: CPO improves ALMA translation models through preference-based training, producing competitive results with limited data and parameter updates.

papers.title: Fewer Truncations Improve Language Modeling
papers.tldr: Best-fit Packing preserves document context without sacrificing training efficiency, improving text and code performance and reducing closed-domain hallucination.

papers.title: Improving Open-Ended Text Generation via Adaptive Decoding
papers.tldr: Adaptive decoding uses changes in entropy-based confidence to choose token candidates and balance text diversity with coherence.

papers.title: Language Generation with Strictly Proper Scoring Rules
papers.tldr: Adapting nonlocal proper scoring rules lets language models train with Brier or Spherical losses, yielding reported generation improvements.

papers.title: Open-Domain Text Evaluation via Contrastive Distribution Methods
papers.tldr: CDM turns differences between stronger and weaker language-model distributions into text-quality measures that better match human judgments on the tested tasks.

papers.title: Principled Gradient-Based MCMC for Conditional Sampling of Text
papers.tldr: The paper develops unbiased gradient-based samplers for discrete text, improving fluency and adherence to soft constraints in its experiments.

papers.title: Switchable Decision: Dynamic Neural Generation Networks
papers.tldr: Dynamic neural generation networks select computation paths per input, reducing inference computation while maintaining accuracy on tested NLP benchmarks.

papers.title: Two Stones Hit One Bird: Bilevel Positional Encoding for Better Length Extrapolation
papers.tldr: BiPE combines absolute positions within segments and relative positions between segments to improve language-model length extrapolation.

papers.title: Aligning Large Language Models with Representation Editing: A Control Perspective
papers.tldr: The method aligns language models by learning a value function that guides edits to hidden states during generation.

papers.title: Alignment at Pre-training! Towards Native Alignment for Arabic LLMs
papers.tldr: The paper studies alignment through Arabic pre-training data and releases models with reported state-of-the-art benchmark performance.

papers.title: Diff-eRank: A Novel Rank-Based Metric for Evaluating Large Language Models
papers.tldr: Diff-eRank measures information redundancy in hidden representations and relates that measure to language-model performance and multimodal alignment.

papers.title: DiffNorm: Self-Supervised Normalization for Non-autoregressive Speech-to-speech Translation
papers.tldr: DiffNorm uses diffusion-based target normalization and source dropout to improve fast, direct speech-to-speech translation.

papers.title: Ensemble Learning for Heterogeneous Large Language Models with Deep Parallel Collaboration
papers.tldr: DeePEn combines heterogeneous language models' token probabilities through a shared representation, improving benchmark performance without additional training.

papers.title: Fit for our purpose, not yours: Benchmark for a low-resource, Indigenous language
papers.tldr: A te reo Māori dataset demonstrates benchmark design centered on Indigenous language communities, speaker diversity, and revitalisation goals.

papers.title: IndicVoices-R: Unlocking a Massive Multilingual Multi-speaker Speech Corpus for Scaling Indian TTS
papers.tldr: IndicVoices-R restores conversational speech into a large Indian-language synthesis dataset and improves zero-shot speaker generalization in the reported fine-tuning comparison.

papers.title: MAGNET: Improving the Multilingual Fairness of Language Models with Adaptive Gradient-Based Tokenization
papers.tldr: MAGNET learns script-specific token boundaries to reduce multilingual over-segmentation while improving modeling speed and downstream utility.

papers.title: Multi-language Diversity Benefits Autoformalization
papers.tldr: Generating informal descriptions from formal mathematics creates useful training pairs, and formal-language diversity improves autoformalization even within one language.

papers.title: Order-Independence Without Fine Tuning
papers.tldr: An input-representation method provably removes dependence on specified subsequence orderings in transformer language models without fine-tuning.

papers.title: PaDeLLM-NER: Parallel Decoding in Large Language Models for Named Entity Recognition
papers.tldr: PaDeLLM-NER decodes entity mentions in parallel, reporting 1.76–10.22 times faster inference while maintaining competitive recognition quality.

papers.title: QUEST: Quality-Aware Metropolis-Hastings Sampling for Machine Translation
papers.tldr: QUEST samples from a quality-guided distribution to produce diverse, high-quality translations without relying on one maximum-scoring output.

papers.title: Scaling Sign Language Translation
papers.tldr: Scaling multilingual, multimodal pretraining improves open-domain sign language translation and demonstrates feasible zero-shot translation.

papers.title: SpeechAlign: Aligning Speech Generation to Human Preferences
papers.tldr: SpeechAlign iteratively optimizes preferences over reference and synthetic codec tokens to improve speech generation and reduce training–inference mismatch.

papers.title: TransVIP: Speech to Speech Translation System with Voice and Isochrony Preservation
papers.tldr: TransVIP combines diverse-data training with direct speech translation and separate encoders for preserving voice characteristics and timing.

papers.title: Zero-Shot Tokenizer Transfer
papers.tldr: A hypernetwork predicts embeddings for new tokenizers, enabling near-original model performance with shorter sequences before additional adaptation training.

papers.title: A Lens into Interpretable Transformer Mistakes via Semantic Dependency
papers.tldr: Transformer answer errors often involve tokens encoding incorrect semantic relationships, whose context dependence makes direct parameter fixes difficult.

papers.title: AEQA-NAT : Adaptive End-to-end Quantization Alignment Training Framework for Non-autoregressive Machine Translation
papers.tldr: AEQA-NAT aligns translation training with inference conditions, achieving autoregressive-comparable performance with substantially more efficient inference in the reported experiments.

papers.title: High-Fidelity Simultaneous Speech-To-Speech Translation
papers.tldr: Hibiki learns word-level translation delays and jointly generates text and speech, achieving state-of-the-art results on French-English simultaneous translation.

papers.title: How to Synthesize Text Data without Model Collapse?
papers.tldr: Editing tokens in human-written text produces semi-synthetic training data that can avoid model collapse and improve performance in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Language Models over Canonical Byte-Pair Encodings
papers.tldr: Enforcing canonical token encodings prevents probability allocation to tokenizer-impossible sequences and improves held-out likelihood in the reported evaluations.

papers.title: Learning from others’ mistakes: Finetuning machine translation models with span-level error annotations
papers.tldr: TWA improves machine translation by learning selectively from annotated error spans and contextually useful non-error spans.

papers.title: Learning to Keep a Promise: Scaling Language Model Decoding Parallelism with Learned Asynchronous Decoding
papers.tldr: Pasta-Lang teaches models to mark semantically independent output for asynchronous generation, delivering reported speedups without reducing generation quality.

papers.title: Long-Short Alignment for Effective Long-Context Modeling in LLMs
papers.tldr: Aligning output distributions across short and long sequences provides a useful diagnostic and an effective training regularizer for length generalization.

papers.title: OptMATH: A Scalable Bidirectional Data Synthesis Framework for Optimization Modeling
papers.tldr: OptMATH generates and verifies optimization-modeling data in both directions, improving models across sizes and producing a challenging benchmark.

papers.title: Overcoming Non-monotonicity in Transducer-based Streaming Generation
papers.tldr: MonoAttn-Transducer adds attention over input history and efficient alignment inference to handle non-monotonic streaming generation.

papers.title: Regress, Don’t Guess: A Regression-like Loss on Number Tokens for Language Models
papers.tldr: Number Token Loss adds numerical proximity to language-model training and improves reported mathematical performance without runtime overhead.

papers.title: TruthFlow: Truthful LLM Generation via Representation Flow Correction
papers.tldr: TruthFlow learns query-specific representation corrections that improve language-model truthfulness and transfer to unseen hallucination benchmarks.

papers.title: Bridging Sign and Spoken Languages: Pseudo Gloss Generation for Sign Language Translation
papers.tldr: LLM-generated pseudo glosses, reordered to align with sign videos, improve translation without requiring expert gloss annotations for the training videos.

papers.title: Calibrating Translation Decoding with Quality Estimation on LLMs
papers.tldr: Aligning translation likelihood with estimated quality improves translation selection and makes likelihood a useful quality signal.

papers.title: CoreaSpeech: Korean Speech Corpus via JAMO-based Coreset Selection for Efficient and Robust Korean Speech Generation
papers.tldr: CoreaSpeech combines Korean-specific text normalization and Jamo-based data selection to support efficient speech synthesis and standardized evaluation.

papers.title: Corrector Sampling in Language Models
papers.tldr: Resample-Previous-Tokens lets a language model revise recent output, yielding roughly 10% relative gains on reasoning and coding benchmarks after fine-tuning.

papers.title: Cosmos: Compressed and Smooth Latent Space for Text Diffusion Modeling
papers.tldr: Cosmos performs text diffusion in a compressed, semantically grounded latent space, achieving competitive quality with faster inference.

papers.title: Dependency Parsing is More Parameter-Efficient with Normalization
papers.tldr: Normalizing biaffine scores reduces the parameter and data demands of dependency parsers while achieving state-of-the-art results in the reported experiments.

papers.title: Distribution-Aligned Decoding for Efficient LLM Task Adaptation
papers.tldr: SVDecode derives a task-aware vector from a short fine-tune and uses it during decoding to improve adaptation without extra trainable parameters.

papers.title: Efficiently Maintaining the Multilingual Capacity of MCLIP in Downstream Cross-Modal Retrieval Tasks
papers.tldr: TaPCL and CiPCL use language-aware sampling and multilingual key terms to adapt MCLIP efficiently while preserving multilingual retrieval capabilities.

papers.title: Explaining and Mitigating Crosslingual Tokenizer Inequities
papers.tldr: Language-specific vocabulary sizes and tokenization across whitespace reduce disparities in token counts between languages.

papers.title: Flexible Realignment of Language Models
papers.tldr: The framework uses controllable logit fusion and an inference adapter to adjust model behavior, demonstrating token savings and flexible reasoning depth.

papers.title: Leveraging Importance Sampling to Detach Alignment Modules from Large Language Models
papers.tldr: RAM uses importance sampling to separate alignment into an independently trained module that reshapes a language model’s outputs.

papers.title: Magical: Medical Lay Language Generation via Semantic Invariance and Layperson-tailored Adaptation
papers.tldr: Magical separates shared medical summarization from selectable lay-language styles to improve fidelity and accessibility with fewer trainable parameters.

papers.title: Multi-Token Prediction Needs Registers
papers.tldr: MuToR inserts learnable register tokens to support multi-token prediction without changing pretrained model architectures.

papers.title: MuRating: A High Quality Data Selecting Approach to Multilingual Large Language Model Pretraining
papers.tldr: MuRating transfers English document-quality judgments into a 17-language evaluator that improves multilingual pretraining data selection.

papers.title: PANGEA: Projection-Based Augmentation with Non-Relevant General Data for Enhanced Domain Adaptation in LLMs
papers.tldr: PANGEA uses unrelated general-purpose data to improve the diversity and quality of synthetic examples for domain adaptation.

papers.title: Parameterized Synthetic Text Generation with SimpleStories
papers.tldr: SimpleStories uses controlled synthetic stories to improve tiny-model sample efficiency and interpretability compared with TinyStories.

papers.title: Probabilistic Token Alignment for Large Language Model Fusion
papers.tldr: PTA-LLM uses optimal transport to learn soft vocabulary alignments, improving the evaluated target model across multiple capabilities.

papers.title: Semantic-guided Diverse Decoding for Large Language Model
papers.tldr: SemDiD guides decoding in embedding space to produce meaningfully different responses while balancing quality, improving reported selection and RLHF results.

papers.title: SimulMEGA: MoE Routers are Advanced Policy Makers for Simultaneous Speech Translation
papers.tldr: SimulMEGA implicitly learns streaming read/write decisions with mixture-of-experts gating, improving reported quality–latency trade-offs without inference overhead.

papers.title: SwitchLingua: The First Large-Scale Multilingual and Multi-Ethnic Code-Switching Dataset
papers.tldr: SwitchLingua provides diverse multilingual code-switching text and speech, alongside a meaning-aware metric that exposes gaps in current speech recognition.

papers.title: Top-H Decoding: Adapting the Creativity and Coherence with Bounded Entropy in Text Generation
papers.tldr: Top-H uses an entropy-constrained sampling formulation to improve creative writing while maintaining coherence and question-answering robustness in reported evaluations.

papers.title: WritingBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Generative Writing
papers.tldr: WritingBench evaluates diverse writing tasks using query-specific criteria and a trained critic, with data-curation results supporting the framework’s usefulness.

papers.title: XIFBench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Multilingual Instruction Following
papers.tldr: XIFBench evaluates multilingual instruction following constraint by constraint, revealing how language resources, complexity, and cultural context influence performance.

papers.title: Beyond Literal Translation: Evaluating Cultural Effectiveness in Social Media UGC
papers.tldr: CULTURE-MT evaluates whether social media translations preserve cultural meaning and emotional resonance that conventional translation metrics can miss.

papers.title: Beyond Perplexity: UTF-8 Validity in Byte-aware Language Models
papers.tldr: UTF-8 generation reliability develops later than perplexity stabilizes, showing that byte-aware models need separate structural-validity evaluation.

papers.title: Contrastive Weak-to-Strong Generalization
papers.tldr: ConG contrasts weak models before and after alignment to generate cleaner training examples for stronger models.

papers.title: Distributional Open-Ended Evaluation of LLM Cultural Value Alignment Based on Value Codebook
papers.tldr: DOVE evaluates cultural value alignment by comparing human and LLM text distributions in a learned value space that preserves subgroup diversity.

papers.title: FiRE: Fine-grained Ranking Evaluation for Machine Translation
papers.tldr: FiRE compares translations by faithfulness, fluency, and style, producing rankings that better match human judgments in the reported evaluations.

papers.title: InstEmb: Instruction-Following Embeddings through Glimpses of the Future
papers.tldr: InstEmb improves instruction-following embeddings by combining input representations with output-aware information from learnable look-ahead tokens.

papers.title: Large Language Models Explore by Latent Distilling
papers.tldr: ESamp uses an adapting predictor of hidden representations to steer generation toward semantic novelty and improve multi-attempt reasoning efficiency.

papers.title: LLM-based Embeddings: Attention Values Encode Sentence Semantics Better Than Hidden States
papers.tldr: Aggregating attention value vectors produces stronger training-free sentence embeddings, with further gains from attention weighting and output-space alignment.

papers.title: MGAL: A Multilingual Granularity-Aware Long-Context Benchmark
papers.tldr: MGAL diagnoses multilingual long-context comprehension across granularity and position, exposing discourse and factual-consistency weaknesses.

papers.title: Mitigating Translationese Bias in Multilingual LLM-as-a-Judge via Disentangled Information Bottleneck
papers.tldr: DIBJudge reduces multilingual judges’ preference for machine-translated text by separating bias-related features from judgment-critical information.

papers.title: mmBERT: A Modern Multilingual Encoder with Annealed Language Learning
papers.tldr: mmBERT improves multilingual encoder performance using phased training that introduces over 1,700 low-resource languages during the decay phase.

papers.title: MORE: A Multilingual Document Parsing Benchmark and Evaluation
papers.tldr: MORE evaluates parsing of real documents across 149 languages, including structural elements beyond plain text.

papers.title: Multiple Choice Learning of Low-Rank Adapters for Language Modeling
papers.tldr: LoRA-MCL uses winner-takes-all training of low-rank adapters to generate diverse, relevant continuations for ambiguous contexts.

papers.title: Names Don’t Matter: Symbol-Invariant Transformer for Open-Vocabulary Learning
papers.tldr: A symbol-invariant Transformer provably ignores semantics-preserving renaming and improves generalization to previously unseen symbols.

papers.title: Omitted Variable Bias in Language Models Under Distribution Shift
papers.tldr: The paper bounds language-model performance under unobserved distribution shifts and uses those bounds to improve evaluation and optimization.

papers.title: Optimizing Diversity and Quality through Base-Aligned Model Collaboration
papers.tldr: BACo routes generation between base and aligned models token by token to improve output diversity and quality together.

papers.title: Position: Express Your Doubts — Probabilistic World Modeling Should Not Be Based on Token *logprobs*
papers.tldr: The paper advocates explicitly predicting event probabilities instead of interpreting token log probabilities as probabilities about the world.

papers.title: Post-Training Language Models for Crosslingual Consistency
papers.tldr: Direct consistency optimization improves agreement across translation-equivalent prompts using a tractable off-policy posttraining objective.

papers.title: Predicting the Order of Upcoming Tokens Improves Language Modeling
papers.tldr: Training models to rank upcoming tokens by proximity improves language modeling overall across the evaluated model sizes and benchmarks.

papers.title: Q-Tab: Quantized Tabular Data Generator
papers.tldr: Q-Tab combines residual lookup-free quantization with masked token modeling to generate statistically faithful and predictively useful synthetic tables.

papers.title: Simultaneous Speech-to-Speech Translation Without Aligned Data
papers.tldr: Hibiki-Zero learns from sentence-level speech pairs and uses reinforcement learning to reduce translation latency without requiring word-level alignments.

papers.title: Text Generation as Continuous Latent Dynamics via Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: CT-LLM combines neural-ODE latent dynamics with reinforcement learning to connect continuous internal evolution and discrete text generation.

papers.title: TokSuite: Measuring the Impact of Tokenizer Choice on Language Model Behavior
papers.tldr: TokSuite isolates tokenizer effects with fourteen otherwise matched language models and a five-language robustness benchmark.

papers.title: What Language is This? Ask Your Tokenizer.
papers.tldr: UniLID identifies languages using tokenizer probabilities, improving low-resource sample efficiency and fine-grained dialect recognition.
